issue.body:
I am trying to change the content-type header of my response but this results in a duplicate header.
I am using FastAPI by the way.

My code:
```python
from starlette.responses import Response

@app.get('/content-type-test')
async def content_type_test(response: Response):
    response.headers['content-type'] = 'application/geo+json'
    return {}
```
Here the result that I receive (notice the duplicate content-type header):
```console
curl -v http://127.0.0.1:8000/content-type-test
*   Trying 127.0.0.1...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to 127.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1) port 8000 (#0)
> GET /content-type-test HTTP/1.1
> Host: 127.0.0.1:8000
> User-Agent: curl/7.58.0
> Accept: */*
>
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< date: Mon, 28 Oct 2019 12:02:44 GMT
< server: uvicorn
< content-length: 2
< content-type: application/json
< content-type: application/geo+json
<
* Connection #0 to host 127.0.0.1 left intact
{}
```
issue.title: Duplicate content-type response header
